flagged.location: Page summary, second prose paragraph, sentence beginning “Two frequency packets separated by at least three dyadic generations…”
flagged.evidence: The page claims that at every level at most one packet survives and their square functions add in Euclidean square, without restricting packet levels. In dimension 1, take packet indices j=-3 and k=0, and nonnegative smooth Fourier bumps supported respectively in (1/16,1/4) and (1/2,3/4). Both lie in the unit ball, where φ₀=1 and every φᵢ for i≥1 vanishes. Hence Δ₀ sees both packets; their inverse transforms are positive at x=0, so the claimed pointwise square identity fails there. The current scoped example supplies the needed restriction 0≤j<k, which the page summary omits.
